Problem: Stopped SAP HANA Cloud instance failed to start with: The requested change is not allowed at this time (Ref IDs: cf7fae2680804894960b, 4c9696bd76a64ba78dce)
Root_Cause: SAP BTP Trial landscape temporarily offline and trial window expired
Troubleshooting_Process: Retried instance start, verified SAP BTP Trial status message, and checked SAP Community reports
Solution: Created a new SAP HANA Cloud instance instead of waiting indefinitely while keeping all local Week 1/Week 2 CSVs and SQL scripts
Result: Zero data loss; full KEYA_MART reload automated via 00_setup_and_load_keya_mart.py

Problem: Instance creation failed with BrokerError: invalid Parameter (databaseMappings) and resourcequota limit of 1 for trial plan hana has been reached
Root_Cause: Creating from BTP Service Marketplace omitted single Space mapping, and old stopped instance held the 1-instance trial quota
Troubleshooting_Process: Switched to SAP HANA Cloud Central and checked existing trial quota usage
Solution: Removed old locked trial instance and provisioned fresh instance through SAP HANA Cloud Central with Allow all IP addresses
Result: New SAP HANA Cloud instance provisioned cleanly
